name: get_weather
description: Get the current weather for a location

city.description: The name of the city, e.g. London or New York

name: get_sys_time
description: Get the current local system time

format_12hr.description: Whether to return the time in 12-hour format with AM/PM (true) or 24-hour format (false). Defaults to false.

label.description: A short label for the alarm

name: take_screenshot
description: Takes a screenshot of the main screen and saves it to the user's Desktop

filename.description: Optional custom filename for the screenshot (e.g. desktop.png). If omitted, a timestamped name will be used.
